front-body.purpose: Lead copy, answers, explanations at width axis 87.5.

shadows.name: panel-hard
shadows.purpose: Structural offset for selected metric panels.

shadows.name: action-hard
shadows.purpose: Depth cue for the primary action and active navigation.

shadows.name: action-pressed
shadows.purpose: Shadow collapses when an action is pressed.

shadows.name: front-none
shadows.purpose: The front page casts no shadows. Lift is drawn with an offset second frame instead: a 1px #0b0b0b frame filled #f1f1ef, inset 10px -10px -10px 10px behind the scanned page (6px on phones).

motion.name: mechanical-snap
motion.purpose: Short transform and shadow feedback on buttons.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for transitions and scrolling.

motion.name: front-ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for front-page state transitions (button fill 160ms, press 120ms, tab and step 160-200ms).

motion.name: front-scan
motion.value: red 2px beam sweep, stops on the cited line
motion.purpose: Signature load interaction while the readouts resolve from real browser checks.

motion.name: front-blink
motion.purpose: Live-state squares and the typing caret.

motion.name: front-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion removes sweeps, rises, and blinks.

narrative.overview: A warm reading surface meets the explicit geometry of a working desk. Black strokes and compact controls make actions easy to find; mint, sky, and butter mark action and state without suggesting unfinished AI behavior is live. The dashboard stays compact and practical, while document content remains calm to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Square geometry and tactile offset shadows

rules.name: The Honest Surface Rule
rules.body: Label samples and distinguish local page-session behavior from server capabilities.

rules.name: The Three Pastels Rule
rules.body: Use mint, sky, and butter; do not add gradients, glow, or glass.

dos: Do use the exact user-specified color values.
Do keep controls keyboard accessible and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't imply prototype files are uploaded, persisted, parsed, or analyzed.
Don't use gradients, glow, or glass effects.

front-page.overview: The front page presents DocuMind as a machine that checks the visitor's own browser live and shows its work. It reads like a printed instrument sheet: a light grey ground ruled with hairlines, black 1px frames, square corners, huge uppercase Anton, and every other word in a narrow monospace. One signal red marks what the machine is pointing at: labels, the cited line, stamps, and live states. Density is high but ordered. Content sits in framed ledgers and ruled rows rather than floating cards, and depth comes from line work, never from blur or block shadows. Every readout shows real data from the visitor's browser or the product's documented facts.
keyCharacteristics: Light grey ground, white framed panels, near-black ink, one red.
1px black frames and 1px hairline grids; square corners throughout.
Anton for display, Martian Mono at width 87.5 for body, labels, readouts, and buttons.
Numbered section marks in a gutter beside the heading.
Live readouts bound to real browser checks.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Signal red is the only accent on the front page. It marks what the machine points at; it never decorates. No second accent, no pastels, no gradients beyond the flat hairline grid.

rules.name: The Real Readout Rule
rules.body: Every number or status the page displays comes from the visitor's browser (WebGPU, free storage, model cache) or from documented product facts. A readout without a real source does not ship.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Anton is reserved for display and headline sizes and the large preview figures. Everything else is Martian Mono at width 87.5; never introduce a third family or a system display face.

rules.name: The Line-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Lift is drawn, never cast. Use a frame, a hairline, an offset second frame, or inversion; never a block shadow, blur, or glow.

dos: Do keep Signal Red (#d3110f) as the only accent, used for section marks, the cited line, stamps, citations, and live states.
Do draw depth with 1px frames, hairlines, the offset second frame, or inversion.
Do bind every readout to a real browser check or a documented product fact, and show an honest unknown when a check cannot resolve.
Do set section numbers /01 to /07 in the gutter beside the heading's first line, topped by a 1px red rule.
Do keep Anton for display and headline sizes and Martian Mono at width 87.5 for everything else.
donts: Don't use block shadows, hard offset shadows, blur, glow, or rounded corners on the front page.
Don't add a second accent color or carry mint, sky, or butter onto the front page.
Don't invent stats, user counts, customer names, or logos.
Don't place section numbers above a heading as an eyebrow or kicker.
Don't carry front-page tokens into the workspace until the user decides to move the workspace to this system.
